# Gary Stow

> Performance marketing specialist and AI practitioner. Builds AI agents
> and automated systems, teaches practical AI skills, and writes about practical AI adoption in performance
> marketing.

Gary Stow is a Senior Client Solutions Manager in performance marketing,
self-taught in Python and GitHub, building AI agents and automation as
personal projects alongside his day job. This site documents that work:
a live, fully automated momentum trading scanner, an automation team of
department, supervisor and manager roles that watches and improves that
system, a local LLM assistant, a research lab for testing trading ideas, and
practical guides and articles on AI tools.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://garystow.co.uk/): overview, about, and links to work,
  agents, articles, speaking and contact.
- [Work](https://garystow.co.uk/work/): the Momentum Scanner, a fully
  automated momentum trading system built from scratch, including how
  it works and the skills demonstrated.
- [AI & Agents](https://garystow.co.uk/agents/): personal AI projects,
  including Wade, the website automation team, the Research Lab and the
  Momentum Scanner, all built in Gary's own time.
- [Articles](https://garystow.co.uk/articles/): republished, longer
  versions of LinkedIn posts on building in public, AI and search, and
  performance marketing.

## Recent articles

- [Why I Built Free Learning Games My Daughters Can Play Together](https://garystow.co.uk/articles/why-i-built-free-learning-games-for-my-daughters/): why Gary built four free, ad-free learning games for his daughters, aged three and eight, so they can play together at their own levels. Times tables, spelling, colours and counting, built with AI in the evenings.
- [Why I Built a Free AI Job Finder, and Why I'm Giving It Away](https://garystow.co.uk/articles/why-i-built-a-free-ai-job-finder/): I've been made redundant before and it was horrible. With a young family on one income, I know that fear. So I built a free AI tool to take some of the stress out of finding the next role.
- [How I Put My Home AI Dashboards on My Phone, Privately](https://garystow.co.uk/articles/how-i-put-my-home-ai-dashboards-on-my-phone-privately/):
  my AI teams run on my home PC, so every decision waited until I was
  sitting at it. Here is how I got the village, my reports and my
  trading dashboard onto my phone in under an hour, without opening
  any of it to the internet, including every error I hit on the way.
- [I Tested 7 Trading Ideas Against Simply Owning the Market](https://garystow.co.uk/articles/i-tested-7-trading-ideas-against-simply-owning-the-market/):
  most trading backtests only ask whether a rule made money. I asked a
  harder question: did it beat simply owning the market over the same
  days? Seven ideas, including my own way of reading charts. Here is
  what held up and what didn't, with every chart and the data behind
  it.
- [Backtesting a Premarket Strategy: 6,444 Rules, No Real Winner](https://garystow.co.uk/articles/backtesting-a-premarket-strategy-6-444-rules-no-real-winner/):
  I wanted an automated version of my premarket trading routine.
  Before trusting it, I built a lab that tested 6,444 versions in
  under ten seconds. Here is what it found, with every chart and the
  data behind it.
- [How to Build a Live Village Dashboard for Your AI Agents](https://garystow.co.uk/articles/how-to-build-a-live-village-dashboard-for-your-ai-agents/):
  every job my AI automations do now shows up as a cartoon village.
  This is the exact recipe, with the code, so you can build your own
  version.
- [The Independent Audit: Why I Make AI Check Its Own Work](https://garystow.co.uk/articles/the-independent-audit-why-i-make-ai-check-its-own-work/):
  AI outputs can be confidently wrong. Asking for an independent audit
  at the end of every task has improved the quality of mine more than
  anything.
- [How to Learn AI as a Marketer With No Coding Background](https://garystow.co.uk/articles/how-to-learn-ai-as-a-marketer-with-no-coding-background/):

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers

- All content on this site reflects Gary's own personal views and
  projects, not those of any employer.
- Specific employers, clients, and internal systems are described in
  general terms only, in line with normal workplace confidentiality.
- Gary is currently focused on training and speaking, not paid
  consulting engagements.
- Any trading results referenced (e.g. account performance figures) are
  from a demo account and are presented as evidence of a working system,
  not as financial advice or investment performance claims.
- [Gary HQ Village](https://garystow.co.uk/village/): Gary's real AI automation teams shown as a live cartoon village.
- [Kids Games](https://garystow.co.uk/kids-games/): free browser games Gary built with AI for his daughters, aged three and eight: a co-op Seek and Find with maths clues, Times Table Pegs, Paint Splash, and Spell & Build (national curriculum spelling lists Year 1 to 6 with a spelling test mode). Quietly educational, no adverts, nobody loses. Any family can set their own children's names, skin tones, hair and eyes, and install it as an offline app. Code: https://github.com/GarySto/kids-games Setup guide: https://garystow.co.uk/guides/how-to-set-up-free-learning-games-for-your-kids/
- [Primary spelling lists, Year 1 to Year 6](https://garystow.co.uk/kids-games/spelling-lists/): the national curriculum in England spelling words for Year 1, Year 2, Years 3 and 4, and Years 5 and 6, free to print, each linked to the Spell & Build game. No adverts, analytics or cookies.
- [Kids Games for teachers](https://garystow.co.uk/kids-games/for-teachers/): a printable summary for schools and clubs of the four free Kids Games, what each one teaches, the age ranges, and the privacy facts (no adverts, accounts, analytics or cookies).
- [Trading Research Lab](https://garystow.co.uk/lab/): Gary's home trading lab - every idea tested against simply owning the market, with interactive charts. Practice money only.
- [News roundup](https://garystow.co.uk/news/): every other Sunday, a short summary of what changed in search, PPC and AI over the last two weeks, and what's worth learning, with links to every source.

## Guides

- [How to Set Up Free Learning Games for Your Kids, and Make Them Look Like Your Family](https://garystow.co.uk/guides/how-to-set-up-free-learning-games-for-your-kids/): step-by-step setup of the free Kids Games on an iPad, iPhone, Windows or Mac computer or Android tablet, making the characters look like your family, adding this week's spellings and choosing times tables. Free to reuse under CC BY-NC 4.0.
- [How to Use AI to Find Jobs That Actually Fit You: Free Prompts for Every Level](https://garystow.co.uk/guides/how-to-use-ai-to-find-jobs-that-fit-you/): Three free, copy-and-paste AI prompts that help you build your own job scoring rubric, check your CV against it and search the web for roles that fit. Starter, intermediate and advanced.
- [How to Run a Free Local AI Model with LM Studio and Use It from Python](https://garystow.co.uk/guides/how-to-run-a-free-local-ai-model-with-lm-studio-and-use-it/): A beginner's step-by-step guide, with annotated screenshots, to choosing a model that fits your PC, running it in LM Studio, switching on the local server, and talking to it from a short Python script.
- [How to Host a Website for Free on GitHub Pages with Your Own Domain and Cloudflare](https://garystow.co.uk/guides/how-to-host-a-website-for-free-on-github-pages-with-your/): A step-by-step guide, with annotated screenshots, to buying a domain, building your first page with AI, putting it live for free on GitHub Pages, adding Cloudflare in front of it, and fixing the settings that quietly hurt my SEO.
